title: Laws of Justice and Feasts

questions.question: How many annual feasts did God command Israel to celebrate?
questions.explanation: Exodus 23:14 (ESV): "Three times in the year you shall keep a feast to me."

questions.question: What does God promise to send before Israel to guard them?
questions.explanation: Exodus 23:20 (ESV): "Behold, I send an angel before you to guard you on the way."

questions.question: What must you not spread?
questions.explanation: Exodus 23:1 (ESV): "You shall not spread a false report."

questions.question: What should you do if you see your enemy's donkey lying under its burden?
questions.explanation: Exodus 23:5 (ESV): "You shall refrain from leaving him with it; you shall rescue it with him."

questions.question: What was the land to do every seventh year?
questions.explanation: Exodus 23:11 (ESV): "But the seventh year you shall let it rest and lie fallow."

questions.question: What are the three feasts named in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Exodus 23:15-16 (ESV): "The Feast of Unleavened Bread... the Feast of Harvest... the Feast of Ingathering."

questions.question: What is forbidden in court regarding the poor?
options: You shall not pervert justice due to a poor man
questions.correctAnswer: You shall not pervert justice due to a poor man
questions.explanation: Exodus 23:6 (ESV): "You shall not pervert the justice due to your poor in his lawsuit."

questions.question: What cooking practice is forbidden at the end of this chapter?
options: Boiling a young goat in its mother's milk
questions.correctAnswer: Boiling a young goat in its mother's milk
questions.explanation: Exodus 23:19 (ESV): "You shall not boil a young goat in its mother's milk."

questions.question: What did God promise to do to the inhabitants of Canaan?
options: Send His terror before Israel and throw them into confusion
questions.correctAnswer: Send His terror before Israel and throw them into confusion
questions.explanation: Exodus 23:27 (ESV): "I will send my terror before you and will throw into confusion all the people."

questions.question: Why would God not drive out the nations all at once?
options: Lest the land become desolate and wild beasts multiply
questions.correctAnswer: Lest the land become desolate and wild beasts multiply
questions.explanation: Exodus 23:29 (ESV): "I will not drive them out from before you in one year, lest the land become desolate and the wild beasts multiply against you."

questions.question: What insect did God promise to send ahead of Israel?
questions.explanation: Exodus 23:28 (ESV): "And I will send hornets before you, which shall drive out the Hivites, the Canaanites, and the Hittites from before you."

questions.question: What would happen if Israel served the gods of the Canaanites?
options: It would be a snare to them
questions.correctAnswer: It would be a snare to them
questions.explanation: Exodus 23:33 (ESV): "They shall not dwell in your land, lest they make you sin against me; for if you serve their gods, it will surely be a snare to you."

questions.question: What borders did God promise for Israel's land?
options: From the Red Sea to the Sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the Euphrates
questions.correctAnswer: From the Red Sea to the Sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the Euphrates
questions.explanation: Exodus 23:31 (ESV): "I will set your border from the Red Sea to the Sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the Euphrates."

questions.question: What must Israel not make with the inhabitants of Canaan?
options: A covenant with them or their gods
questions.correctAnswer: A covenant with them or their gods
questions.explanation: Exodus 23:32 (ESV): "You shall make no covenant with them and their gods."

questions.question: What blessings did God promise for obedience regarding food, water, and health?
options: He would bless their bread and water, take sickness away, and give full lifespan
questions.correctAnswer: He would bless their bread and water, take sickness away, and give full lifespan
questions.explanation: Exodus 23:25-26 (ESV): "He will bless your bread and your water, and I will take sickness away from among you... I will fulfill the number of your days."

key_verse_text: Behold, I send an angel before you to guard you on the way and to bring you to the place that I have prepared.
